notes: v4 desk switches. Read by retire.py (retirements, Kronos) and v4 modules. config/policy.json stays frozen for the main v3 ledger and is not read for any of this.

legacy_forward_tests.old: legacy forward test (not from a published source)

legacy_why: Nick, 2026-10-31: keep the `old` ledger (policy_old.py, frozen 2026-10-28.3 rules) opening paper trades exactly as before, shown next to the v4 ledgers with the same metrics.
retired_why: docs/STRATEGY_PLAN.md section 1: no edge over matched random entries on the desk's own data (v3, ORBX, lab families), or rules that pay the IV crush (earn_pre). Code and history are kept; open trades are still managed to their exit.
kronos_why: Kronos forecasts are off by default in v4 (STRATEGY_PLAN section 1). The KRONOS=1 environment switch alone no longer starts it; this flag must also be true.
tracking_why: Nick, 2026-10-31: a fresh-start view. Each strategy is scored as its own paper account of account_usd from start (Research page, GET /api/v4/tracking). Changing it changes only the view, never the trades or the journal.
sprint_paper_why: Nick, 2026-10-31: paper-only forward tests of the sprint's near-miss backtests (fb_or = setups_v2-012, otm_put = otm_v1-011, otm_bounce = otm_v1-042, watch-only). Nick, 2026-11-01: add otm_h = rule H (FIN-H: otm_v1-040 taken only when f_rvol >= 1.06), out-of-sample tested, not promoted. Simulated fills on live quotes, never real money. Not promoted: promotion needs CLAUDE.md step 5. false stops a ledger's new entries; open trades are still managed to their exit.
etf10_rsi2_why: Nick, 2026-11-10 ("go"): paper forward test of T6 R2 (rsi2 F1 on 10 ETFs; BACKTEST research 1997-2021 and sealed 2022-2025 both passed). The only v4 ledger that holds overnight (swing book). Simulated fills on live quotes, never real money; promotion needs 40 forward trades (CLAUDE.md step 5). false stops new entries; open positions still exit by rule.
nb_shares_why: Nick, 2026-11-10 ("sure we can do that"): paper forward test of T12a/T12b, the noise band on SPY shares (BACKTEST research 2003-2021 and sealed 2022-2025 both passed). Intraday, flat at the close. Simulated fills on live quotes, never real money; promotion needs 40 forward trades per ledger. false stops new entries; open positions still exit by rule.
pead_t21_why: Nick, 2026-11-11 ("yes"): paper forward test of T21, post-earnings drift on S&P 500 shares (BACKTEST research 1997-2021 and sealed 2022-2025 both passed; sealed market-adjusted about 0). Multi-day (pead book, 20 sessions). Simulated fills on live quotes, never real money; promotion needs 40 forward trades. false stops new entries; open positions still exit by rule.
pead_t21_tp_why: Nick, 2026-11-11 ("do whatever you think is best"; take profits instead of waiting for a date): paper forward test of T23a = T21 + a take-profit at fill x (1 + sigma20 x sqrt(20)) near the close (BACKTEST research and sealed both passed, and made more dollars than T21 in both). Runs beside pead_t21 (unchanged) in the pead book, its own 5 slots. Simulated fills, never real money; promotion needs 40 forward trades.
core_spy_why: Nick, 2026-11-11 ("do 1 first": hold the market as the core with the tested strategies on top, using margin; then "u do whats best" on the risk rule): paper forward test of T30b = SPY core sized to the account + nbs_spy_ls + etf10_rsi2, minus 6.5% margin interest (BACKTEST in-sample portfolio arithmetic beat SPY alone in 2003-2021 and 2022-2025). Core rule (Claude, delegated): isolated core book, exempt from the 1.5% multi-day size rule and the account throttle; paper only. Simulated fills, never real money. false stops the first entry and rebalances; an open core is kept.
fomc_source: Federal Reserve 2026 FOMC meeting calendar (second day of each meeting = statement day). Used only when config/events.json has no calendar for the day. Verify against federalreserve.gov before relying on it.
